title: What is the total insurance fee paid?
description: A fee in paise for each passenger is multiplied by one lakh passengers and changed into rupees. A last step shares the total back among the passengers.
teaching_notes: One idea: multiply in paise first, then change the total to rupees. Watch for children who treat the answer in paise as rupees.

source: Figure it Out (end of chapter), Q12
video_script.why: The child has changed paise into rupees and now uses it on a total for many people.
video_script.substitution: Multiply the fee in paise by the number of passengers, then divide by one hundred to get rupees.
video_script.anchor: a railway e-ticket with an insurance fee of forty-five paise
video_script.payoff_line: Change the total from paise to rupees by dividing by one hundred
video_script.fraction_reading: no fractions are read in this video
video_script.design: The ticket stays in the anchor band with its fee. The fee is multiplied by one lakh in paise, the total is changed to rupees, and a last step shares the total back among the passengers.
open_questions: The book says 1 lakh people; the script says lakh aloud and writes 1 lakh as 100000.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; a railway e-ticket marked insurance 45 paise for each passenger; 1 lakh passengers; a question mark in the anchor band

marks.list: the ticket and the fee are drawn

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about travel insurance on railway tickets.
<bookmark mark='list'/>Insurance costs forty-five paise for each passenger who books an e-ticket. One lakh people take it in a day.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>We have to find the total insurance fee paid by all of them.

beats.on_screen: the ticket stays on the board; Keeko sits beside it as the child
a one rupee coin cut into 100 paise; an arrow from paise to rupees marked divide by 100

marks.coin: the coin is cut into one hundred paise
marks.div: the arrow from paise to rupees is marked divide by 100

narration: <bookmark mark='coin'/>A rupee has one hundred paise, so one paisa is a hundredth of a rupee.
<bookmark mark='div'/>Paise change into rupees by dividing by one hundred.

beats.on_screen: Given: 45 paise for each passenger; 1 lakh passengers
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, forty-five paise for each passenger, and one lakh passengers.

beats.on_screen: To find: the total fee paid, in rupees
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the total fee paid, in rupees.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: 1 lakh = 100000 passengers; total = 45 x 100000 paise
narration: <bookmark mark='lakh'/>Step one, one lakh is one hundred thousand.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>Each passenger pays forty-five paise, so we multiply by the number of passengers.
<bookmark mark='prod'/>Step two, forty-five times one lakh is forty-five lakh paise.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: 100 paise = 1 rupee, so 4500000 paise ÷ 100 = 45000 rupees
narration: <bookmark mark='hund'/>Step three, one hundred paise make one rupee, so we divide the paise by one hundred.
<bookmark mark='div'/>Dividing forty-five lakh by one hundred gives forty-five thousand rupees.

beats.on_screen: Step 4: check 4500000 paise ÷ 100000 passengers = 45 paise each

marks.chk: 45000 rupees is changed back to 4500000 paise

narration: <bookmark mark='chk'/>Step four, put the answer back. Forty-five thousand rupees is forty-five lakh paise.
<bookmark mark='each'/>Shared among one lakh passengers, that is forty-five paise each.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Change the total from paise to rupees by dividing by one hundred.
<bookmark mark='val'/>The total insurance fee is forty-five thousand rupees.
